limitations: Wild-type C57BL/6J experiments use male mice aged three to four months. Genetic cohorts include males and females pooled after reported baseline comparisons; experimenters were blinded to genotype only. The stated birth-order randomization and counterbalancing do not specify the random sequence. Grubbs outlier exclusions and a greater-than-five-percent initial hyperemia inclusion rule are reported without a complete included/excluded-animal manifest.

Arf6iECKD is partial, inducible endothelial knockdown, with about thirty percent reduction attributed to the referenced characterization. Both genotypes receive tamoxifen, 2 mg per mouse daily for five days, followed by at least one month washout. It is not complete Arf6 loss or a capillary-only intervention.

The ATP-depletion assay uses mixed microvessel lysates, including endothelial cells, distal pericytes and astrocyte endfeet. Residual ATP is an inverse kinase-activity proxy under added substrate/cofactors, not direct membrane PIP2 concentration. GTPgammaS is not selective for Arf6. Results give 0.012% DMSO whereas Methods give 0.01%; exact solvent concentration needs resolution.

NAV-2729 is pharmacological and not exclusively Arf6-selective. Main Methods describe additional GEF/GAP targets in overlapping concentration ranges. Genetic comparisons and supplementation constrain interpretation but do not identify a unique PIP2-mediated route or exclude effects in other neurovascular cells.

Whole-cell currents use 60 mM external potassium and are measured separately from focal 10 mM capillary stimulation. For pharmacological protection, bath diC16-PIP2 is present before recording; it is not a sequential rescue of the same cell after current loss. Repeated ramps and cells nested within mice do not provide independent animal replications.

Myography pools pressure-induced tone and U46619 preconstriction; it measures upstream diameter, not propagated membrane voltage. The printed tone formula is prestimulated/maximal diameter, whereas the Results and Figure 3B describe constriction from maximal diameter. This normalization needs resolution before numerical reuse.

Laser Doppler responses are relative perfusion, not absolute flow, BOLD or spike rate. Manual whisker stimulation precludes estimating propagation kinetics. NAV or vehicle is superfused for twenty minutes; genetic PIP2 flow rescue is a separate cohort from the barium comparison, not a repeated rescue in the same animals.

Figure 4b reports four to seven animals for traces whereas Figure 4c reports six to eight for animal summaries. Technical trial counts also need reconciliation with the Methods average of three trials. The Ba2+-sensitive fraction in Figure 4f is normalized to the total response; the Methods subtraction formula omits that denominator. No precise fraction or dose-response fit is calibrated.

Vehicle alone increases the Figure 4c hyperemic response. Concurrent NAV/PIP2 preserves a response relative to its own baseline but does not fully restore the higher vehicle-treated response, as acknowledged in the Discussion. Nonsignificance between treated genotypes is not equivalence; no complete physiological rescue or clinical efficacy is established.

Separate supporting information, animal identifiers, raw recordings and analysis code remain unread or unavailable here. Main Figures 1-4 and Methods support scoped reported outcomes, not independent reproduction of data, exclusions, nesting or statistics. Supplemental genotype, blood-pressure, glucose and lower-dose controls are not independently admitted.

PIP2 availability is inferred from kinase and Kir current assays; the study does not directly quantify membrane lipid abundance or test all Arf6 pathways. Cross-preparation consistency does not prove that this is the sole mediator of blood-flow responses or a universal rule for constructing the graph.

Grubbs outlier exclusions and a greater-than-five-percent initial hyperemia inclusion rule are reported without a complete included/excluded-animal manifest.

Both genotypes receive tamoxifen, 2 mg per mouse daily for five days, followed by at least one month washout. It is not complete Arf6 loss or a capillary-only intervention.

The ATP-depletion assay uses mixed microvessel lysates, including endothelial cells, distal pericytes and astrocyte endfeet. Residual ATP is an inverse kinase-activity proxy under added substrate/cofactors, not direct membrane PIP2 concentration. GTPgammaS is not selective for Arf6. Results give 0.012% DMSO whereas Methods give 0.01%; exact solvent concentration needs resolution.

NAV-2729 is pharmacological and not exclusively Arf6-selective. Main Methods describe additional GEF/GAP targets in overlapping concentration ranges. Genetic comparisons and supplementation constrain interpretation but do not identify a unique PIP2-mediated route or exclude effects in other neurovascular cells.

For pharmacological protection, bath diC16-PIP2 is present before recording; it is not a sequential rescue of the same cell after current loss. Laser Doppler responses are relative perfusion, not absolute flow, BOLD or spike rate. Manual whisker stimulation precludes estimating propagation kinetics. NAV or vehicle is superfused for twenty minutes; genetic PIP2 flow rescue is a separate cohort from the barium comparison, not a repeated rescue in the same animals.

Results give 0.012% DMSO whereas Methods give 0.01%; exact solvent concentration needs resolution.
